pageSubtitle: Printable parts that work with Attraccess. Everything is generated in your browser.
cardDescription: A 60 x 40 x 2 mm tag with a keyring hole and a pocket for a 25 mm RFID sticker.
labelDescription: Shown large in the middle of the card. Shrinks automatically to fit.
previewAriaLabel: 3D preview of the keychain card. Drag to rotate.
printTip: Two colours: import both parts together. Pause at Z = 1.125 mm to drop in the RFID sticker, then resume.
errorNoOutput: Some characters in this label can't be engraved. Try letters, numbers and basic punctuation.
plugDescription: A two-part cover that stops people pressing the smart plug's button or pulling the cable. Two 3 × 5 mm passages take security seals.
plugDeviceDescription: The Nous profile comes from the CAD model of the original cover. The Shelly profiles are estimated from published sizes: do a test fit and raise the clearance if needed.
plugShellyPlusGen3: Shelly Plus Plug S / Plug S Gen3
plugDeviceClearanceDescription: Added to the diameter on top of the 0.5 mm nominal fit. Raise it if the cover is too tight.
plugCableDescription: Straight cables pass through an opening in the cover. Angled cables leave through a 30.9 mm slot in the cover and a 34.2 mm cutout in the body.
cordOpeningDiameterDescription: Diameter of the opening and slot the cable passes through. Measure your cable and add about 2 mm. Default: Schuko 12 mm, Euro 9 mm.
heightAbovePlugDescription: How far the cover reaches above the smart plug's face. Raise it for a tall angled plug. Default: 17.8 mm.
cableCutoutHeightDescription: Height of the cutout in the body that the angled cable leaves through. Default: 24.2 mm.
plugPrintTip: Print body and cover separately and check the fit on your smart plug first. Fit both around the smart plug, then close both 3 × 5 mm passages with disposable security seals.
plugPreviewAriaLabel: 3D preview of the smart plug security cover. Drag to rotate.
plugErrorNoOutput: The cover could not be generated with these settings. Try the default values.
